purpose: Teach: 同名/気配り/調査官/貸借/割当/局員/上半期/釈明

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文に同名のテーマがある場合は副題で区別しろ
lines.en: Ren — when papers share the same title, distinguish them with subtitles.
lines.style: Clear, measured instruction. Light emphasis on the principle itself, not on Ren's mistake. The tone of someone who's seen this problem before and knows the solution. Slight pause before the expectation settles.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。お得意様に当たる学会の偉い先生方への気配りを学習中です
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm learning how to be thoughtful with the senior researchers at the conference.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not robotic — there's actual awareness in his voice that this is something he's consciously working on. Quick acknowledgment, then a small admission of effort.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究倫理調査官の指導には誠実に従え
lines.en: Ren — follow the research ethics investigator's guidance sincerely. Don't cut corners.
lines.style: Firmer than before. The word 'sincerely' lands with quiet weight. Not a threat — a principle being named. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験機材の貸借契約を確認しました
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've checked the equipment rental agreements.
lines.style: Quick, competent confirmation. No flourish — just the fact stated cleanly. The tone of someone who did the work and is reporting it done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の役割割当を整理しろ
lines.en: Ren — organize the lab's role assignments. Get it clear on paper.
lines.style: Direct instruction with an implied urgency. The emphasis lands on 'organize' — not busy-work, actual structure. The voice expects follow-through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会事務局員の方々と連絡を密にします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll stay in close contact with the conference administrative staff.
lines.style: Responsive and engaged. No hesitation — he's already thinking about how to do this. The phrase 'close contact' shows he understands the implication that this needs attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、上半期の研究成果をまとめろ
lines.en: Ren — compile the first half's research results. Make it count.
lines.style: Expectation without doubt. The pause before 'Make it count' adds weight — this matters. Hiroshi is passing the baton here, not just assigning a task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データミスがあれば釈明資料を準備します
lines.en: Yes, sir. If there are any data errors, I'll have clarification documents ready.
lines.style: Quiet diligence. Not anxious, just thorough — he's already thinking one step ahead about what could go wrong and how to handle it gracefully. The closing trails slightly, confident but careful.
